title: The approximate tangent plane field of an integer multiplicity triple is measurable
statement: For every integer multiplicity triple R = (M, θ, ξ) in a set U ⊆ ℝ^P (IMRep U n), the map x ↦ p_{T_xM}, the orthogonal projection onto approxTangentPlane n M x (the approximate tangent plane T_xM where it exists, {0} otherwise), is H^n⌞M-almost everywhere strongly measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) (μHE[n].restrict R.carrier)
